The '''2019 LPL Summer''' split was the second split of the year in China’s franchised '''LoL Pro League''' (''LPL''), organized by TJ Sports. Sixteen teams competed from 1 June to 6 September across home-and-away venues in Shanghai, Chengdu, Chongqing, Xi’an, Suzhou, Beijing, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and Foshan. The split used a Single Round Robin Regular Season followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket, with the champion qualifying for the [[World Championship/2019|2019 World Championship]]. Matches were played offline on patches ranging from 9.10 to 9.15. Two teams entered the split under new names: [[SinoDragon Club]] rebranded to [[Dominus Esports]], and [[Snake Esports]] became [[LNG Esports]].

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 1st - August 18th, 2019''
** Single round robin, {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th till 8th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''9th till 16th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
****1st, 4th, 5th, and 8th seed will be in one bracket. The other 4 seeds will be in the other.
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World_Championship/2019|Worlds 2019]]
